text: HEFB 222/KNFB 222 Culturally Responsive Pedagogy Credits: 3. 2 Lecture Hours. 3 Lab Hours. Overview: 2 Lecture Hours. 3 Lab Hours. Developing an understanding of students in multiple settings and levels; development, structure, history, finance, and management of schools in a democratic society; philosophical, ethical and moral dimensions of teaching; professional role of teacher. Prerequisite: Kinesiology and Health majors. Cross Listing: KNFB 222/HEFB 222 . Prerequisite: Kinesiology and Health majors. Cross Listing: KNFB 222/HEFB 222.

text: HEFB 324/KNFB 324 Technology and Teaching Skills for the 21st Century Learner Credits: 3. 2 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. Overview: 2 Lecture Hours. 2 Lab Hours. Preparation of future Health and Physical Education teachers with practical skills related to: technology in the classroom/gymnasium, strategies for addressing urban education and English language learners, liability, management and classroom discipline, development of professional communication skills and time management; includes field based experiences in diverse classroom settings. Prerequisite: Grade of C or better in HEFB 222/KNFB 222 or KNFB 222/HEFB 222 ; grade of C or better in BIOL 107 or BIOL 111 ; grade of C or better in PHYS 201 or CHEM 119 ; junior or senior classification.
